scoreInterpretation: Comparative visual observations against original,target and approved family; no numeric approval threshold was used.
observations: The original’s dark flat support is replaced by a clearly honey-colored curved bearing,rounded leg sections,foot cuffs and restrained small pins. The support follows the turn and reads as a coherent physical construction in N/E/S/W; no floating corner or unsupported deck appears.

Coral rails have continuous warm edge reflections and soft side values. Blue-gray slats gain layered groove shading without obscuring the belt surface. The turn joins the approved straight family without an abrupt tint/value stripe; every facing retains the same palette and light treatment.

At logical128px and actual phone55/32px cells,the outside/inside turn,slat flow,rail thickness and wood support remain distinct. Detail becomes subordinate at32px as expected,while identity and joins remain readable. No clipping,alpha fringe,black dead patch,coplanar shimmer or directional ground shadow was observed in the accepted native frames/consumer views.

All24 frame samples are present and unique in each facing. Native phase evaluation follows−7*i/24 through frame25 closure; current12fps playback shows coherent incoming-to-outgoing travel and no visible loop jump,port pulse or stationary join stripe. The separate plate follows the curve at the established deck support height and clears the rail.

Exact evaluated open deck/rail cross-sections and the original angular deck UV/geometry are preserved. The source’s0° intrinsic corner orientation is retained. Native connected rendering,independent modules and a genuinely welded native reference remain visually continuous through both perpendicular joins.

The initially retained E55/frame11 connected screenshot is visibly malformed/torn and was inspected as adverse evidence. It is not dismissed as an aesthetic difference. The packet also contains correctly labeled stable isolated retries and a source/frame/rect/native-canvas-bound36case stress audit with no failures. My separate fresh-browser recreation of that exact case in all3 assembly modes and live frame transitions did not reproduce tearing. These independent checks support acceptance of the current asset/consumer output; the historical capture cause is not proven.
remainingDifferences: The target has broader painterly glows,more inflated edge rounding and more prominent fasteners. Candidate highlights/detail are quieter and more systematic to remain continuous with the locked approved family. This is acceptable at the delivered use sizes.
Open profile geometry and the original angular slat parameterization deliberately replace the target’s rounded/capped end treatment. The target is not a continuity or registration authority.
Support grain and joinery are simplified compared with the target; some large-view bearing variation is visible but does not become noise or a dead spot at use size.

Convenience GIFs encode80ms per frame(12.5fps) because their supplied83/84ms values are quantized by GIF timing. They are visual previews,not timing proof. The native24-frame/12fps contract and actual browser/HTML playback remain correct.
